description: 救護所一覧 [fire, police and emergency services] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 静岡市. 災害時に地域で応急的な医療救護活動を行うために開設される救護所の一覧. Coverage: 静岡市. The portal files it under the publisher 静岡市. Its tags are 医療, 救護所, 災害, 災害時医療, 病院. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2026-04-15 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
